review: Exercises 4 and 5 test the same thing: both check that 손 means 'hand' (4: 'hand' → 손/송/솜, 5: 소_ (meaning: hand) → ㄴ). Replace exercise 5 with a different word from the word list, e.g. '누_ (meaning: snow) → ㄴ', '이르_ (meaning: name) → ㅁ' or '고_ (meaning: ball) → ㅇ'.

Exercises 1 and 3 use the same syllables, 방/반/밤, and exercise 2 repeats the same ending-to-hint (-ng/-n/-m) matching and reuses 방. Most of the word list (공, 빵, 눈, 산, 이름) never appears in any exercise, so the goal of 'reading simple words that contain these batchim' isn't practised. Replace exercise 3 with words from the list, e.g. '빵(__) 산(__) 이름(__) → -ng, -n, -m', or with an exercise asking learners to sort 공/눈/산/봄 by final sound.
